text:
Evan: Quick check  We need a concise SEO checklist for the launch posts + webinar landing. Keywords, canonical decisions, JSON-LD, internal anchors, and a redirect plan. Who wants redirects?
Maya: I can do redirects. Please export the legacy URL list and backlink priority. I'll mark 301 vs 302.
Ruth: I'll finalise keyword intent tiers today and share a CSV. Primary target: 'launch webinar best practices'.
Omar: For schema, Event + FAQ on the landing. Also add HowTo on the benchmarks post. I'll draft JSON-LD snippets.
Evan: Good. For internal linking, use CTA anchor text 'See benchmark results' across posts pointing to webinar. Keep consistent fragment IDs.
Maya: Tiny ops snippet for redirects I'll include in PR:
```
# ops sample
location /old-insights { return 301 https://redwood.ai/resources/insights; }
location /exp/variant { return 302 https://redwood.ai/exp/variant; }
```
seo-bot: crawl report: 8 legacy URLs with backlinks, 5 orphaned pages, 3 tag hubs thin. Recommend 301 for backlinks.
Evan: Action items: Maya -> redirect sheet + PR; Ruth -> keyword CSV + priority; Omar -> JSON-LD bundle + schema string alignment to <title>; I'll compile canonical decisions and anchor map.
Maya: I'll upload the spreadsheet and open a PR by EOD.
Ruth: Uploading keywords.csv to the launch drive now.
Omar: Posting JSON-LD snippets in 30m.
Evan: Meeting to sign off 09:30 PT tomorrow. Keep updates here.
